messages:
lina: Quick heads-up: Orion Security just sent back the completed part of the questionnaire. They flagged our statement about 'no persistent PII storage' because their POC needs to log transaction IDs. They want a checklist showing where trade_id is guaranteed non-null.

omar: thanks. Are the failures the same as last thread? (schema validation + null trade_id)

lina: yes, same. They also asked if we can provide a signed SOC-style attestation for the POC while they evaluate.

samir: status on root cause: logs show intermittent token truncation when model response crosses chunk boundary in streaming mode. That produces literal nulls in some generated JSON keys if model emits token 'null' or outputs empty string for the value.

infra-bot: quota-alert org=orion limit=200 qps current=420 status=throttled

samir: also seeing spikes of client retries causing bursts to exceed org quota. We should recommend client backoff and server-side rate-limits.

lina: customer asks if we can pin model to non-streaming generation to avoid boundary issues, even if that increases latency. Any objections?

dwight: non-streaming will be more robust for JSON schema but could increase latency and token cost. For a POC it's fine. We should offer both: streaming for speed, full-response (non-stream) for strict schema validation.

omar: quick mitigation plan:
- enable route config: json_mode.stable_key_order=true and json_mode.drop_nulls=true for their POC route
- add route override to force non-streaming generation for validation runs
- temporarily increase org qps quota to 500 for next 3 hours while they run tests
- provide a short doc snippet for client backoff + Retry-After handling

lina: can someone push the route change now? I'll coordinate with their security lead.

samir: pushing canary now. infra-bot: config-change by samir for route/orion-poc: {"json_mode":{"stable_key_order":true,"drop_nulls":true},"streaming":false} rolling to canary

dwight: log check: canary run returned 0 schema violations across 12 runs. No 429s in canary window.

lina: sending Orion security a note: "We've applied a deterministic JSON serializer and a non-streaming validation endpoint for POC runs. trade_id will be present when the upstream source is provided; we will not fabricate or persist PII. We will provide an attestation PDF by EOD."

omar: followed up with pricing: for dedicated small pool trial we're offering 30% off for first month for POC. dwight will check capacity.

dwight: capacity ok for a week with small pool. I'll spin up if they accept.

lina: next steps:
- samir to open INF ticket for permanent fix and tests
- dwight to prepare capacity change & cost estimate
- omar to draft SOC-style attestation (POC-level)
- lina to schedule final validation run with Orion security at 10:30 PT tomorrow

samir: INF-9831 created: "Orion POC: handle streaming->json nulls + tests" https://go.redwood/infracase/INF-9831

omar: sales note: I'll prepare procurement email for the discounted dedicated trial and include a short runbook for validation runs.

lina: thanks team. Re-open if anything pops up. :white_check_mark:
